title: MongoDB
label: MongoDB
desc: Document database with a flexible BSON model, rich queries and an aggregation pipeline.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Run the server in a container, install the shell and confirm the build that answers.

snippets.code:
# Start MongoDB 8.0 with a root user and a named volume
docker run --name mongo8 \
  -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME=admin \
  -e MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD=devsecret \
  -p 27017:27017 \
  -v mongo8-data:/data/db \
  -d mongo:8.0

# Follow the startup log until the server reports it is ready
docker logs -f mongo8

# macOS: install only the shell and point it at an existing server
brew tap mongodb/brew
brew install mongosh
mongosh --version

# Confirm the container from the host
mongosh "mongodb://admin:devsecret@127.0.0.1:27017/?authSource=admin" --eval 'db.version()'

sections.title: Connection
sections.description: Build a URI for local, replica set or Atlas deployments and reuse it from drivers.

snippets.code:
# Local server with credentials created in the admin database
mongosh "mongodb://admin:devsecret@127.0.0.1:27017/?authSource=admin"

# Replica set: name the set so the client can find the primary
mongosh "mongodb://app_user:devsecret@db1:27017,db2:27017/inventory?replicaSet=rs0&authSource=inventory"

# Atlas DNS seed list
mongosh "mongodb+srv://app_user:devsecret@cluster0.ab1cd.mongodb.net/inventory?retryWrites=true&w=majority"

sections.title: Documents
sections.description: See how BSON documents nest objects, arrays and typed values under one _id.

snippets.code:
// One document mixing scalars, an embedded object and arrays
db.products.insertOne({
  _id: ObjectId("665f1c2ab7e4a91d3c8f0a11"),
  sku: "KB-87",
  name: "Mechanical Keyboard",
  price: NumberDecimal("129.90"),
  tags: ["input", "wireless"],
  dimensions: { width: 36, depth: 13, unit: "cm" },
  createdAt: ISODate("2026-02-14T09:30:00Z"),
  inStock: true,
})

sections.title: Inserting
sections.description: Write one document, a batch, or a mixed set of operations in a single call.

sections.title: Finding Documents
sections.description: Read documents with projections and control the cursor before fetching.

snippets.code:
// Distinct values, a count and one projected document
db.orders.distinct("status")
db.orders.countDocuments({})
db.orders.findOne({}, { total: 1, _id: 0 })

sections.title: Filtering and Sorting
sections.description: Express range, array, text and logical conditions, then order the results.

snippets.code:
// Range, set membership and existence
db.orders.find({ total: { $gte: NumberDecimal("100.00") } })
db.orders.find({ status: { $in: ["pending", "paid"] } })
db.orders.find({ shippedAt: { $exists: false } })
db.orders.find({ status: { $ne: "cancelled" } })  // also matches missing status

// null matches an explicit null and a missing field
db.orders.find({ shippedAt: null })

// Match inside embedded documents and arrays
db.orders.find({ "items.sku": "KB-87" })
db.orders.find({ items: { $elemMatch: { sku: "KB-87", qty: { $gte: 2 } } } })
db.orders.find({ tags: { $all: ["gift", "priority"] } })
db.orders.find({ "items.0.sku": "KB-87" })  // position matters here

sections.title: Indexes
sections.description: Speed up reads with single, compound, unique, TTL, partial and text indexes.

snippets.code:
// Single-field, compound and unique indexes
db.orders.createIndex({ status: 1 })
db.orders.createIndex({ customerId: 1, createdAt: -1 })
db.customers.createIndex({ email: 1 }, { unique: true })
db.orders.createIndex({ status: 1 }, { name: "status_lookup" })

sections.title: Aggregation Pipeline
sections.description: Shape data through stages: filter, group, join, unwind and branch.

snippets.code:
// Revenue per customer, highest first
db.orders.aggregate([
  { $match: { status: "paid" } },
  { $group: { _id: "$customerId", orders: { $sum: 1 }, revenue: { $sum: "$total" } } },
  { $sort: { revenue: -1 } },
  { $limit: 10 },
])

sections.title: Backup and Restore
sections.description: Dump and restore logical backups, compressed or scoped to one collection.

snippets.code:
# Compressed logical backup of one database
mongodump \
  --uri="mongodb://admin:devsecret@127.0.0.1:27017/?authSource=admin" \
  --db=inventory \
  --gzip \
  --archive=inventory-2026-11-04.archive.gz

# Restore it under a different database name
mongorestore \
  --uri="mongodb://admin:devsecret@127.0.0.1:27017/?authSource=admin" \
  --nsFrom="inventory.*" \
  --nsTo="inventory_restore.*" \
  --gzip \
  --archive=inventory-2026-11-04.archive.gz

# Back up one collection, limited to orders created this year
mongodump \
  --uri="mongodb://admin:devsecret@127.0.0.1:27017/?authSource=admin" \
  --db=inventory \
  --collection=orders \
  --query='{ "createdAt": { "$gte": { "$date": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z" } } }' \
  --out=/backup/orders

# Consistent snapshot on a replica set: data plus the oplog window
mongodump --uri="mongodb://app_user:devsecret@127.0.0.1:27017/?replicaSet=rs0" \
  --oplog --gzip --archive=/backup/full-2026-11-04.archive.gz

# Replay up to a point in time, in seconds since the epoch
mongorestore --uri="mongodb://app_user:devsecret@127.0.0.1:27017/?replicaSet=rs0" \
  --oplogReplay --oplogLimit=1762300000:1 \
  --gzip --archive=/backup/full-2026-11-04.archive.gz

sections.title: Common Errors
sections.description: Read the usual failures by their message and apply the direct fix.

snippets.code:
MongoServerError: Authentication failed.
  Wrong password, wrong authSource, or the user lives in another database.
  Add ?authSource=admin when the user was created in admin.

MongoNetworkError: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:27017
  mongod is not running, or the container port is not published.
  Check docker ps and publish it with -p 27017:27017.

E11000 duplicate key error collection: inventory.customers index: email_1
  A unique index already holds that value.
  Update the existing document or retry with upsert: true.

MongoServerError: not primary and secondaryOk=false
  The write reached a secondary node.
  Connect through the replica set seed list or use readPreference=primary.

MongoServerError: Document failed validation
  A $jsonSchema validator rejected the shape.
  Compare required fields and bsonType with db.getCollectionInfos().

BSONObjectTooLarge: object to insert too large
  The document exceeds the 16 MiB limit.
  Split the array or move the payload to GridFS.

// Check roles, replica set state and recent server errors
db.runCommand({ connectionStatus: 1 })
db.hello()
db.adminCommand({ getLog: "global" }).log.filter((line) => line.includes("E11000"))
